notes: Official Lord of the Fries Australia menu pages publish per-serving nutrition for individual items, including Energy (Cal) and Protein (g).

Lord of the Fries describes the chain as vegan and vegetarian friendly, but these rows only mark vegetarian true; strict vegan suitability should still be checked against the current ingredients and allergen text for each item.

Official disclaimer: food may be manufactured in facilities that process non-vegan products, may contain traces of non-vegan material, and nutrition is indicative because products vary from state to state.
Serving sizes differ materially by item and variant. Do not merge big/premium burgers, HSP sizes, fry types, or munch boxes without explicit nutrition rows.
Some official side pages list kilojoules and protein but leave Energy (Cal) blank, such as Nuggets and Fried Chick'n; those items are intentionally omitted.
HSP nutrition rows on the official page appear internally unusual for carbohydrate/sugar/sodium column placement, so only the clearly named per-serving calories and protein are proposed here.
removed: Removed on 2026-08-21: the chain has no NSW presence. The official site lists stores in VIC, WA and SA only, and the last NSW outlet (Newtown) closed. The nutrition rows were correct; the location was not.
